single.rationale: IBEX shows solid momentum with 9.8% revenue growth, improving margins (8.3% operating margin in FY2025 vs. 7.7% in FY2024), strong FCF generation, and aggressive buybacks (14% share count reduction). However, client concentration risks, macroeconomic headwinds affecting BPO demand, and AI disruption uncertainties warrant monitoring before deeper commitment.

team.thesis: ibex delivered a recovery year in FY 2025 with 9.8% revenue growth to $558.3M following a prior-year decline, though the 3-year CAGR of 4.2% reveals modest underlying momentum, while operating margins of 8.3% remain structurally constrained despite 97% offshore/nearshore capacity and the company depleted its balance sheet through aggressive share repurchases that reduced cash from $62.7M to $15.3M
